name: Make an order plugin HPOS compatible
query: WooCommerce says our plugin is incompatible with High-Performance Order Storage. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Run check_plugin_basics to find wc-order-* findings
Step 3: Replace post meta/WP_Query/SQL on orders with wc_get_order(), wc_get_orders(), and order CRUD + save()
Step 4: Add HPOS column and meta box hooks alongside the legacy ones
Step 5: Declare custom_order_tables compatibility on before_woocommerce_init
Step 6: Test with HPOS on and off
success_criteria: No post APIs or wp_posts SQL remain for orders
Compatibility declared only after the code is fixed
Admin columns/meta boxes work on both order screens
